items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And he had John Williams on alto... What a band they had.

ctx.x: In those days no other trombone player you would hear that was making them like that in his solos.

And he had John Williams on alto and, of course, Cecil himself played tenor, and Don Fry played piano, Lloyd played drums, and they had Hubert Mann, a banjo player from Pittsburgh. He played the banjo.
What a band they had. They made some records for Victor.
